checks.title: Audit log on, Copilot interactions retained
checks.remediation: Enable unified audit log ingestion; Copilot interactions are recorded as CopilotInteraction events once it is on.
checks.narrative: Without the audit log there is no record of what Copilot read or who asked. It is the first hard gate because every later question about Copilot exposure needs it.

checks.title: SharePoint Advanced Management available
checks.remediation: SharePoint Advanced Management comes with Microsoft 365 Copilot licences (verify current bundling) or as an add-on; it carries the oversharing reports and restricted access control.
checks.narrative: The oversharing baseline, restricted access control and restricted content discovery all sit behind this licence. Without it the stopgaps are not available.

checks.title: Oversharing baseline run within 90 days
checks.remediation: Run the data access governance reports in the SharePoint admin center (Everyone except external users, broad sharing links, external sharing) and import the export.
checks.narrative: The baseline is the list of sites Copilot would surface too widely. Everything after this gate works that list.

input.label: Data access governance reports
input.steps: In the SharePoint admin center open Reports, then Data access governance. Run the reports (sharing links, everyone-except-external, potentially oversharing sites) and download the CSV files. Add them here; the newest one dates the baseline.

checks.title: Default sharing link is Specific people
checks.remediation: Set the default sharing link type to Specific people in the SharePoint sharing settings.
checks.narrative: Organisation-wide links are what Copilot grounds on: a file shared to everyone in the organisation by default is a file Copilot will quote to anyone who asks.

checks.title: Anonymous links disabled or expiring
checks.remediation: Disable Anyone links, or require them to expire within 30 days.
checks.narrative: Anyone links are outside every identity control; Copilot does not surface them, but the same oversharing habit that creates them creates the internal exposure.

checks.title: Sensitivity labels published with an encrypting top tier and container labels
checks.remediation: Publish the label taxonomy to all users, encrypt the top tier, and enable site and group protection on the labels.
checks.narrative: Copilot honours labels: an encrypted file it cannot read, it cannot quote. Labels are the end state the stopgaps buy time for.

checks.title: Restricted access control on every top-tier site
checks.remediation: Apply restricted access control to each listed site until its access review completes; it is a stopgap, not the end state.
checks.narrative: Restricted access control binds a site to a group regardless of how its content was shared. On the top tier it stops Copilot surfacing the site to anyone outside that group while owners clean up.

checks.title: Restricted content discovery on sites pending review
checks.remediation: Turn on restricted content discovery for the sites the baseline flagged and nobody has reviewed yet.
checks.narrative: Restricted content discovery hides a site from Copilot and organisation-wide search without changing permissions. (verify) PnP exposes the site flag.

checks.title: Restricted SharePoint Search off, or on with an allow list
checks.remediation: Leave restricted SharePoint search off once the baseline is clean; while it is on, keep the allow list populated and a sunset date recorded.
checks.narrative: Restricted search is the bluntest stopgap: Copilot and search see only the allow list. On with an empty list means nobody finds anything.

checks.title: Site access reviews initiated from the baseline
checks.remediation: Initiate a site access review for every site the baseline flagged and track completion.
checks.narrative: The review is where the site owner decides who should still have access. Completion percentage is the progress measure for the readiness page.

input.label: Site access reviews started
input.steps: From the data access governance report, start a site access review for each flagged site, then record the date here.

checks.title: Recurring Entra access reviews on privileged roles and guests
checks.remediation: Create recurring access reviews for the privileged roles and for guests, quarterly or better.
checks.narrative: Copilot widens what a stale permission reaches. Recurring reviews are how permissions stay current after the clean-up.

checks.title: Access packages for standard access
checks.remediation: Deliver the top shared resources through access packages with an approver and an expiry.
checks.narrative: Ad hoc sharing is the source of the oversharing baseline; packages replace it with requested, approved, time-bound access.

checks.title: DLP policy for the Copilot location
checks.remediation: Create a DLP policy with the Microsoft 365 Copilot location that excludes the sensitive labels from Copilot processing, and enforce it.
checks.narrative: The Copilot DLP location stops Copilot summarising or quoting files that carry the excluded labels. (verify) how the policy exposes that location in PowerShell.

checks.title: DSPM for AI reviewed
checks.remediation: Open Data Security Posture Management for AI in Purview, enable it, and action or schedule its oversharing recommendations.
checks.narrative: DSPM for AI is Microsoft's own view of Copilot exposure. There is no read API; the review is recorded as portal evidence.

input.label: DSPM for AI reviewed
input.steps: Open DSPM for AI, review the recommendations and the sensitive interactions report, then record the date here.

checks.title: Copilot settings governed
checks.remediation: Record the web grounding decision, the Copilot Studio and agent governance stance, and the Graph connector review in the admin center evidence.
checks.narrative: Web grounding, agents and connectors each widen what Copilot can reach. The decisions belong recorded; the API to read them is not there yet (verify).

input.label: Copilot settings reviewed
input.steps: In the Microsoft 365 admin center open Copilot settings: web grounding, agents, connectors, data access. Confirm each is set on purpose, then record the date here.

checks.title: Label inheritance verified by test
checks.remediation: Ask Copilot to summarise a file carrying the top-tier label and confirm the output inherits it; record the date in the profile's operations answers (copilotLabelInheritanceTestedUtc).
checks.narrative: The test proves the taxonomy survives Copilot: output labeled as restrictively as the most restrictive source.

checks.title: Copilot not deployed ahead of the oversharing baseline
checks.remediation: If Copilot is already deployed, run the baseline now and work the flagged sites first; this row is a status, not a grade.
checks.narrative: A tenant that licensed Copilot before baselining its sharing is exposed today; the row says so and dates it.

input.label: Data access governance reports
input.steps: Same files as C3. With a baseline on file, Copilot deployment is no longer ahead of it.

checks.title: No ownerless sites
checks.remediation: Assign owners to the ownerless sites and enable the ownerless group policy; nobody can review a site nobody owns.
checks.narrative: Site access reviews need a site owner to answer them. Ownerless sites are the ones the clean-up cannot reach.
